Every frame comes from the C++ assembler and solver. Straight P1 triangles; degree-six assembly quadrature; degree-eight error integration. Surface and nodal-error views use the same P1 interpolation. Error norms compare against the continuous exact formula. These examples validate selected smooth problems, not arbitrary PDE stability.
